_about: Feline's mod library (Mods page → Mod library). Each mod is a shared mod .zip, the kind Feline's Share button makes. 'sha256' is optional but recommended: Feline refuses a download that doesn't match it. Example entry: {"id": "cat-sounds", "name": "Cat sounds", "author": "you", "description": "Meows instead of oofs.", "thumbnail": "https://…/cat-sounds.png", "download": "https://…/cat-sounds.zip", "sha256": "…"}
